infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NeWay TMS uses the camera to scan BOL, POD and receipts for your loads.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: NeWay TMS lets you pick photos of documents to send to the office.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NeWay TMS adds your location to a breakdown or receipt you report, so Fleet knows where you are.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: NeWay TMS uses Face ID to unlock the app instead of your password.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NeWay TMS listens when you ask Ask NeWay a question by voice.
